faq.q: What is the cheapest per-person cost for a hen party yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: The cheapest per-person cost is around €83 per person for a 2-hour charter on the Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40, which each take up to 9–11 guests. That includes the skipper, fuel, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, light snacks, and VAT.

faq.q: How many guests can we bring on a hen party yacht charter in Marbella?

faq.q: What is included in the hen party yacht charter price?

faq.q: What is the best boat for a hen party of 12 people?
faq.a: For a group of 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is ideal. It costs €4,719 for a 4-hour minimum charter and includes a free jet ski. Alternatively, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a flybridge for socialising.

faq.q: How do I book a hen party yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: Booking is done via WhatsApp. You can message the team to check availability for your preferred boat and date. No online booking system – just direct chat. Prices for boats outside Tier A and B are given on request.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for hen party yacht charters?
faq.a: Cancellation policies are typically flexible but depend on the specific boat and season. It's best to confirm directly via WhatsApp when booking. Generally, deposits are non-refundable but may be transferable to another date.

faq.q: What time of year is best for a hen party yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: The best months are May to October, when sea temperatures are 20–26°C and air temperatures 25–35°C. July and August are peak season, so book early. Evenings in June and September are perfect for sunset cruises.

data.body_html:
Planning a hen party in Marbella and wondering about the marbella yacht charter hen party budget for 2028? You're in the right place. We break down the per-person costs, boat options, and what's included so you can plan without surprises. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, with prices starting at €749 for a 2-hour outing on a sleek Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40. Whether you're a group of 5 or 12, here's exactly what you'll pay per head.

Hen Party Yacht Charter Per-Person Cost Breakdown

Here's how the numbers stack up for a hen party on a Tier A boat (Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40). Prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

DurationTotal PriceMax GuestsCost Per Person (9 guests)Cost Per Person (11 guests)
2 hours€7499–11€83€68
4 hours€1,4999–11€167€136
8 hours€2,2999–11€255€209

For a larger group of 12, the Mangusta 80 (Tier B) costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, which works out to €393 per person. That includes a free jet ski – perfect for an extra adrenaline hit.

Which Boat for Your Hen Party Size?

Choose based on your group size and vibe. Here are our most popular hen party boats:

  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h. Great for a budget-friendly group.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h. Similar price, slightly smaller capacity.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719/4h. Includes a jet ski.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request. Flybridge for sunbathing.
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) – pricing on request. Sporty and fast.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request. Ultra-luxury option.

All depart from Puerto Banús. For smaller groups of 5, the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are available – pricing on request.

What's Included in the Price?

Every hen party charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper (no need for a boating licence)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% tax)

No hidden extras. You can bring your own cake, decorations, or a playlist. The boat has a Bluetooth speaker and a cooler.

Sample Hen Party Itinerary in Marbella

A typical 4-hour charter from Puerto Banús might look like this:

  • 15:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús. Board your Azimut 39 or Mangusta 80.
  • 15:15 – Depart towards the coast. Pop the cava and enjoy snacks.
  • 16:00 – Anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming and photos.
  • 17:00 – Cruise along the Golden Mile, past Marbella Marina and La Concha mountain.
  • 18:00 – Jet ski session (if on Mangusta 80) or more swimming.
  • 18:45 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark with memories.

For an 8-hour charter, you can extend to Estepona or Sotogrande for lunch.

How to Keep Your Hen Party Budget Low

To minimise per-person costs:

  • Book a 2-hour charter on the Azimut 39 (11 guests) – €68 per person.
  • Go for a weekday rather than weekend – availability is better.
  • Choose May, June, or September – lower demand and pleasant weather.
  • Bring your own cake or snacks to supplement the provided drinks.
  • Split the cost evenly via a group payment app.

Remember: all prices include VAT and skipper, so there's no tipping required unless you're delighted.

Why Puerto Banús for a Hen Party?

Puerto Banús is the heart of Marbella's luxury scene. You'll be surrounded by superyachts, designer shops, and beach clubs. After the charter, you can hit the famous Ocean Club or Pangea for dinner and dancing. The marina is safe, well-lit, and has plenty of parking. It's also a short walk from the Golden Mile hotels and villas.
